brief:
Political analyst Slieman Bisharat told Shehab Wire that recent Israeli statements, particularly from Israeli Defence Minister Yisrael Katz, reflect an Israeli effort to complicate conditions in Gaza. Bisharat characterized the remarks as part of a deliberate strategy aimed at avoiding progression to the second phase of ceasefire negotiations.

The analyst's assessment suggests Israeli officials are using public statements to create procedural and political obstacles to advancing talks. Bisharat indicated the pattern of statements serves to fragment consensus around moving forward with agreed-upon negotiation phases, effectively stalling momentum in Gaza-related discussions.
